package com.potionprofitpro.stats;

import lombok.Getter;

@Getter
public enum StatSection
{
	DAY("Last day"),
	WEEK("Last week"),
	ALL("All time"),
	AVERAGES("Averages"),
	BEST_RUN("Best Run"),
	ALCH("Alchemist's Amulet"),
	BOUNTY("Amulet of Bounty");

	private final String title;

	StatSection(String title)
	{
		this.title = title;
	}
}
